title: SemiMemes: A Semi-supervised Learning Approach for Multimodal Memes Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a semi-supervised learning model (SemiMemes) to detect harmful content in memes, such as misogyny and hate speech. While these topics have ethical dimensions and 'religion' is mentioned as a potential subject of harmful memes, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics themselves; rather, it benchmarks the classification performance of its model on established datasets.
